title: Stale listing follow-up
description: A seller discusses a slow campaign and agrees to a fresh appraisal call.
outcome: Agent callback booked for Monday morning

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Hi Shiqi, this is Leo, Buta’s assistant from Buta Deogun.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: I noticed the property at [property address redacted] has been on the market for 97 days.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: I just wanted to check in and see how things have been going with the sale.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Is it an okay time for a quick chat?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yeah, I’ve got a few minutes from now. How can I help you?

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Great, thanks for taking the time.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: How has the sale been progressing for you so far?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: You know, it has been on the market for around 100 days, and it wasn’t really good.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: I’m sorry to hear that.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: It sounds frustrating.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: What kind of buyer interest or feedback have you received so far?

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: And have there been any offers?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yeah, I got a few ones, but the price is kind of low, so I didn’t accept them.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Thanks for sharing that.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Would you be open to a brief, confidential, no-obligation call with Buta for a fresh perspective on the sale?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yeah, why not? If Buta can help me, I’m glad to have one.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Okay, that’s awesome.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: What day and time would suit you for a callback from Buta?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: How about next Monday?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Morning or afternoon?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: That’s fine.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Just to confirm, Buta will call you back next Monday morning. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yeah, yeah, it’s cool.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Okay, we’ll arrange for Buta to call you back next Monday morning.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Okay, that’s awesome.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Thank you. Have a good one.
